Trang An's best boat route is the one they won't offer you: Route 3, the King Kong route. 3.5 hours, 1,000m of dark cave, and the valley from Kong: Skull Island. Same 250,000 VND ticket as the crowded routes — just ask for Route 3 by name at the counter. https://vietadvisor.travel/ninh-binh/trang-an

Rented a bike in Ninh Binh for $5. Shared the road with cement trucks for 3 hours. Next day, paid $35 for a guide who took me on dirt paths through rice paddies with lunch at a family home. The $35 was the better deal. 🚲

https://vietadvisor.travel/ninh-binh/ninh-binh-bike-tour
